title: Randomized simulation of quantum channels using small ancilla
summary: We study the problem of implementing a quantum channel using a small ancilla with classical randomization and postselection on an output failure flag. The simulation is probabilistic, but exact conditioned on success. We prove that any unital channel on a $d$-dimensional system can be simulated with ancilla dimension $k$ and success probability $Ω(\frac{k}{\log d})$. Equivalently, every unital channel on $n$ qubits can be simulated with constant success probability using only $O(\log n)$ ancillary qubits.
